servinfo.title: Seat Heater System Description (If Equipped)
servinfo.ptxt: The seat heater system consists of a seat cushion heater incorporating a thermostat and seatback heater at each of driver and passenger seats, and a seat heater switch. The seat heater system is so designed that while the seat heater switch is “ON”, the seat temperature is maintained within the specified range repeating on and off of the thermostat, namely, when seat temperature concerned is below 30 °C (86 °F), the thermostat turns on the electric current and when the temperature goes up to 40 °C (104 °F), the thermostat turns off the current.
